sources.title: Nikon: 5 Easy Composition Guidelines
sources.supports: Thirds intersections are placement guides rather than rigid exact coordinates. Empty space ahead of a gaze or action vector is directional; a stationary object does not acquire a travel vector merely by being off center.
sources.inspected: Full article text, sections Rule of Thirds, Lean Into the Frame, Leading Lines, and Look Carefully.
sources.claim_limits: Guidelines admit exceptions; thirds placement does not guarantee image quality.

sources.title: Canon: Tips for Better In-Camera Composition
sources.supports: Defines negative space around the main subject and illustrates open space balancing subjects on the opposite side. Discusses contrast, sharpness, and directional lines as compositional variables.
sources.inspected: Full educational article body by Eric Stoner, including the thirds grid, space, leading-line and contrast examples.
sources.claim_limits: Example balance is contextual, not an optical force measurement or a universal percentage rule.

sources.title: Adobe: Mastering photography composition techniques
sources.supports: Visual weight can be distributed through empty space, tone and color without mirrored objects. Lines should direct attention into the intended subject; multiple composition techniques can coexist.
sources.inspected: Full article body, especially Leading lines and Symmetry and balance.
sources.claim_limits: No source prescribes a cup/spoon arrangement; any such scene is an authored illustration rather than a sourced photograph.

confusion_boundaries.meaning: Arrangement within the frame does not prescribe shot scale, top-down camera, aspect ratio, crop-safe platform margins, or printed panel structure.

A coherent broad low-detail region may contain subtle tone or texture. A small cue can coexist elsewhere; assigning a secondary object inside an explicitly fully empty region would be a contradiction requiring scene-level resolution.
Primary and secondary objects have unequal visual roles; symmetric identical objects are a different arrangement. Visual balance is contextual and must not be described as measured physical mass.

Existing sources name primary mass, secondary cue, field and their relations. A scene must bind those roles to its already declared owners. No source creates a cup, spoon, person, extra prop or new count.
The subject position relative to image boundaries supplies thirds evidence; a drawn grid is not the composition itself.

confusion_boundaries.boundary: Negative space versus publication copy space
confusion_boundaries.meaning: An open field alone does not authorize visible lettering, a caption, reserved logo area, or a platform overlay.
Profile evidence, retrieval appearance and empty effect arrays do not grant adoption. Full source qualification and selected-owner contract review remain necessary.
